newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy CPI to pick up when demand recovers-Minister.
newsitem.headline: Italy CPI to pick up when demand recovers-Minister.

text.p: Foreign Trade Minister Augusto Fantozzi said Italian CPI inflation could start to rise slightly when domestic consumer demand picks up but this would not be a cause for concern.
"Inflation is coming down very well. When domestic demand recovers there could be a slight upturn, but nothing to worry about," he told reporters at a conference.

Analysts generally expect CPI inflation to fall below the 2.0 percent level in April with many forecasting a rate as low as 1.8 percent. But they see inflation creeping up slightly in the second half of this year.
